name: JSON Tools
description: Adds a Format permission and a format command. A member who holds the permission can pretty-print a JSON string or run it as a JSON code block; only whitespace changes, so key order, duplicate keys and number text stay as written; invalid JSON comes back as an error with a line/column location.

changes: Re-indents your JSON as written instead of rebuilding it, so key order and numbers stay as they were.
Asks for fewer capabilities when you install it.

author: slim-m

permissions.name: Format JSON
permissions.description: Pretty-print a JSON string or JSON code block.
